questions.answer: Consistency of measurement under relevant conditions.
Evidence supporting a score interpretation for its intended use.
Relative position in a specified norm distribution, not 70% possession of a trait.
questions.feedback: Ask which norm population was used.

questions.prompt: Can research validity automatically justify recruitment use?
questions.answer: No; evidence must support the particular consequential use and population.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only. Use answer-specific feedback and delayed retest.
scoring.practice: Audits a fictional instrument's construct, consistency, validity, norms and intended use without administering or diagnosing.
scoring.transfer: Prepare a one-page critique of a fictional personality tool. Include a construct definition, distinction between reliability and validity, interpretation of a hypothetical percentile and three evidence gaps. Recommend a bounded use, or explain why no use is justified.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
